acceptanceCriteria: Provide or document an existing supported read-only Core roadmap/bf command that emits the exact current ##/### intake headers and their owning shard mapping without manual raw-shard parsing.

Prove returned headers can be used by the canonical add resolver; preserve ambiguity and absent-header refusal, roadmap locks and queue authority, and verify that discovery itself writes no queue state.

Preserve source/current-head binding; any new substantive owning Core tooling implementation requires its focused checks, full owning gate and independent review. Keep this reference intake OPEN until actual owning delivery or a verified existing supported route resolves it.
body: Observed supported-CLI discovery friction on2026-09-30 at Core362c30c7e32a126840d672b0f589b7724febe17c while peer wanted to file a separate nonblocking Apple fixture follow-up without raw shard reads. roadmap.sh add requires an actual ##/### header substring and resolves through roadmap_lib.py:961–981; filename is not that header. roadmap.sh count --json by_section returns shard filenames, export-md prints only ticket blocks, bf roadmap-ticket exposes no section header, and bf evidence-get is a directory-based evidence reader (actual attempted source read returned exit2). Consequently the examined supported queue reads do not supply a verified header to the owner; do not guess a substring or claim filename routing. Retained failed supported read /tmp/oscillux-canonical-intake-section-bf-evidence.json. This is confirmed concrete workflow friction and a bounded missing-discovery proposal, not a claim that every unknown CLI route is broken. Corvint query returned NEEDS_WIDENING and unrelated feature:section-sources, not queue authority. Dedup native Corvint searches section/header found no matching Core CLI intake; read-only source/CLI help examined. Tools Core163 Tasks202; current native Core sharded roadmap remains the sole executable authority. This Corvint EXTERNAL tooling intake is reference only under machine owner automatic filing, no competing queue, no source/claim changes. Native Apple review at unchanged feb179f is separately intent_pass; do not reopen or amend its candidate for this intake. Current routing resolved by owning peer: supported add accepted exact header substring Milestone 2 and committed314b7de01 for the two Apple follow-ups. The general header-discovery friction remains a low-priority idea, not an active delivery blocker.
title: Expose canonical roadmap section headers for safe follow-up intake routing
